metadata.case_name: NG CHING v. LINK MACHINERY WORKDS LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: artisan / machinist (duty was to cut and polish steel cylinders with the lathe)

injuries.description: laceration to the upper right arm with muscle lacerated; partial cut of the underlying brachialis muscle
source: Dr Lin stated in his report of 9 September 2003 that the Plaintiff had suffered a laceration to the upper right arm of about 30 cm which was deep at the medial side with muscle lacerated, there was no active bleeding and no neurovascular deficit.

A medical memorandum dated 14 August 2003 by Dr Kam Wing Lok of the Orthopaedic Department recorded that the Plaintiff had a 15 cm deep laceration over the right arm region and a partial cut of the underlying brachialis muscle, but the neurovascular structures were intact.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: injury / damage to the lateral cutaneous (cutaneous) nerve of the right forearm (superficial sensory nerve)
source: Dr Lam assessed ... the numbness was compatible with injury of the lateral cutaneous nerve, a superficial nerve.
There was a patch of decreased sensation of about 6 cm x 3 cm.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of cutaneous sensory nerve at forearm level

injuries.description: wound healed with scarring (unsightly scar on right arm)
source: The wound eventually healed with scarring.
Despite the Plaintiff's full recovery, there is an obvious unsightly scar on his right arm.
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

manifestations.description: numbness over the lateral aspect of the forearm; no sensation over the part distal to the wound even when pinched
paraesthesia over the right dorsum of the forearm
pain in the distal arm and scar pain; stretching pain over right forearm scar on exerting force
weakness in his right upper limb including reduced grip (as complained/reported to Dr Lam)
patch of decreased sensation of about 6 cm x 3 cm

treatments_received: A & E treatment at Yan Chai Hospital
admission to orthopaedic ward at Yan Chai Hospital
remedial class training and work rehabilitation

losses.description: Obvious unsightly scar on his right arm which would put him under a disadvantage in seeking new jobs.
